component.name: Immich Splash
component.summary: Back up photos and videos to your Immich server

description.p: An unofficial desktop companion for a self-hosted Immich server. It sits in the system tray and backs up the folders you choose, checking with your server first so nothing is uploaded twice, and lets you browse your library: photos, albums, people, places, a map, sharing and the locked folder.
Immich Splash is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Immich project.
